description: Compare the capabilities a Play node declares with the context APIs its source uses. Reports missing (the host will refuse the call) and unused (reviewers will ask) capabilities. Static heuristic: treat 'unused' as a prompt to check, not proof.

declared.description: Declared capabilities. Omit to read them from the definePlayNode manifest.

directory.description: The Play node project or its src folder
